description:
The Huffy Disney Frozen Light-Up 3-Wheel Scooter brings the magic of Arendelle to every ride. Featuring colorful Elsa and Anna graphics, this scooter inspires imaginative adventures while encouraging kids to get outside, stay active, and explore with confidence.
With every push and glide, the LED light-up deck creates a sparkling display beneath little riders' feet. The glowing lights add excitement to every sidewalk and driveway adventure, making each ride feel like a magical journey through a winter wonderland.
A stable 3-wheel design helps young riders build balance and coordination while learning to scoot. The wide non-slip deck provides secure footing, while lightweight construction and kid-friendly steering make it easy for beginners to ride, turn, and have fun on every adventure.
